plugins.name: Link Rewrite (YOURLS)
plugins.description: Rewrite outgoing article links using one or more self-hosted YOURLS short-link providers at delivery time, with SQLite caching, domain exclusions, and optional strict retry mode.

plugins.name: ntfy Push
plugins.description: Reference HTTP Bridge channel plugin delivering RSS articles as push notifications to ntfy.sh or self-hosted ntfy servers with topic, priority, tags, and bearer token auth.
plugins.compose_snippet:
services:
  feedcourier-ntfy:
    image: ghcr.io/elleryhe/feedcourier-plugin-ntfy:latest
    environment:
      BRIDGE_SECRET: "replace-with-strong-secret"
      PORT: "8787"
    restart: unless-stopped
